$comment: Channel Routing's round 3 (Q2.5, Fen): every crew has its own channel, and you match each crew to the place it works, as the workspace selector does for a session. `places` come in the selector's order (keys 1-3; `island` is the island's picture for each; the game runs `worktree` down the crew's channel, `checkout` into the Great Hall, and `cloud` up the gondola). Each crew's `order` is one row of the course's "Choose it when..." column; `accept` lists every right place (`best` is the one Wingman's hint picks); `right` and `why` are what a place says (unvoiced; Fen says `lines.best.<place>`). For the Copilot app course: 02 §Where a Session Runs ("When in doubt, choose a new worktree").

feature.order: Build the reading list. Keep its changes, branch and diff apart from main, on your machine.

why.checkout: Feature’s changes ran through the Great Hall, your working folder. To keep them apart from main, pick New worktree.
why.cloud: Cloud runs it off your machine. Feature wants its own folder and branch right here: New worktree.

bugfix.order: A long job to offload. Keep your own machine untouched.

why.worktree: A new worktree still runs on your machine. To offload the work and keep your deck untouched, send it by Cloud.
why.checkout: Current checkout works right in your folder, the opposite of untouched. Send Bug Fix by Cloud.

docs.order: Just a quick, low-stakes look at the README. Touching your working folder is fine.

right.checkout: Right: a quick, low-stakes look can run in your current checkout.
right.worktree: That works too. A new worktree is the safe default; for a quick look, Current checkout is fine as well.

why.cloud: Cloud offloads the work. For a quick, low-stakes look, Current checkout is fine, and a new worktree is the safe default.

text.pickHelp: Pick where each crew works: New worktree, Current checkout or Cloud. Use the arrow keys or 1 to 3, then open the gates.
text.pickFirst: Pick a place for every crew first.
text.solved: Every crew works where its order fits.
text.intro: Every crew has its own channel. Now pick where each one works.
text.hintDone: Every crew’s in the right place, Captain. Open the gates!
text.hint1: Read each crew’s order. Own channel, a quick look, or off your deck?
text.title: Where does each crew work?
